stories.story_fr: UPS a tenu son appel de résultats du premier trimestre 2026 le 28 avril 2026.
stories.story_en: UPS held its first quarter 2026 earnings call on April 28, 2026.

stories.story_fr: Le deck indique que Carol B. Tomé est PDG, Brian Dykes CFO et PJ Guido responsable des relations investisseurs.
stories.story_en: The deck lists Carol B. Tomé as CEO, Brian Dykes as CFO and PJ Guido as Investor Relations Officer.
stories.quote: CAROL B. TOMÉ BRIAN DYKES PJ GUIDO Chief Executive Officer Chief Financial Officer Investor Relations Officer

stories.story_fr: Le document comporte des déclarations prospectives mentionnant des risques comme les changements de politique commerciale mondiale, les tarifs et l’incertitude géopolitique.
stories.story_en: The presentation includes forward‑looking statements noting risks such as global trade policy changes, tariffs and geopolitical uncertainty.
stories.quote: These risks and uncertainties include, but are not limited to: changes in general economic conditions in the U.S. or internationally, including as a result of changes in the global trade policy, new or increased tariffs, government shutdowns, or geopolitical uncertainty, tensions and/or conflicts in or arising from various countries and regions, including the European Union, Ukraine, the Russian Federation, the Middle East and the TransPacific region
